name: Surprising Drop
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Prop: orb
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You toss your orb nonchalantly into the fray, watching it shatter with a resounding clap of thunder. Each creature within the burst takes 1d8 points of sonic damage +1 point per caster level . If a creature fails a Fortitude save, it is deafened until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding an orb, you also push one target to 10 feet directly away from you if it fails its Fortitude save. The burst creates a zone of resounding thunder that lasts until the end of your next turn. Any creature that enters the zone or starts its turn there is deafened until the end of your next turn if it fails a Fortitude save.
